text: dsh-claude-mem 是一个把 claude-mem 跨会话记忆接入 DSH 的插件，通过本地 worker 的 HTTP API 提供记忆检索、会话时间线、观察详情读取、手动保存和上下文文本获取。它向 DSH 注册五个记忆工具和 mem-search 技能，并可在会话开始注入项目上下文；还可选配工具结果摄取和轮次结束总结。默认启用上下文注入，摄取与总结默认关闭。适合希望在 DSH 会话间查找和复用项目记忆的用户。需要预先运行 claude-mem worker，默认连接本机地址，也可配置 worker URL。

dsh-claude-mem connects claude-mem to DSH through a local worker API. It registers tools for memory search, timelines, detail retrieval, saving and context, plus a search skill. Session context injection is on by default; ingestion and summaries are optional. Requires a running worker.
想让 DSH 在新会话开始时带入之前的项目记忆。
我想搜索以前会话里记录过的解决方案。
能不能按关键词查找跨会话保存的观察记录？
需要查看某条记忆前后相邻的时间线内容。
想把重要信息手动存进长期记忆，之后再查。
希望从搜索结果中挑出几个记录并读取完整详情。
I want DSH to bring relevant project memories into a new session.
How can I search notes saved across earlier sessions?
I need to inspect the observations around a particular memory entry.
dsh-claude-mem 的功能「搜索跨会话记忆」：调用 mem_search 按自由文本查询记忆，并可按项目、类型、日期、平台及排序分页筛选；先返回索引条目，便于选出需要继续读取的记录。
dsh-claude-mem 的功能「查看记忆时间线」：调用 mem_timeline，以记录 ID 或查询作为锚点，获取其前后相邻的记忆条目；可指定前后深度及项目或平台筛选。
dsh-claude-mem 的功能「读取、保存和获取上下文」：使用 mem_get_observations 按 ID 取回记录详情，mem_save 手动保存文本记忆，或 mem_context 获取 worker 渲染的项目上下文。
dsh-claude-mem 的功能「自动注入与会话生命周期」：会话开始时可初始化 worker 会话并注入项目上下文；可选记录筛选工具的文本结果，或在轮次停止时请求会话总结。
dsh-claude-mem 通过 HTTP 连接已运行的 claude-mem worker；默认地址为本机回环地址，也可由 DSH_MEM_BASE_URL 或 baseUrl 指定。

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · dsh-claude-mem：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that integrates [claude-mem](https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem): query persisted cross-session memory, inject per-project context at session start, save manual memories, and drive session summarization — all through a local claude-mem worker's HTTP API.

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · dsh-claude-mem：It registers the model-facing tools `mem_search`, `mem_timeline`, `mem_get_observations`, `mem_save`, and `mem_context`, the `mem-search` skill, and the lifecycle hooks (`agent/session-start` context injection, optional `tools/post-execute` ingestion, optional `agent/turn-stopping` summarization). It is a single self-contained package with no monorepo-only dependencies.

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Install：One-liner with `npx` (no global install — `npx` fetches the `dsh` launcher and
`dsh plugin` forwards `add` to pnpm in the target profile):

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile demo add @bleed00/dsh-claude-mem
```

If you already have `dsh` on `PATH`, the same command without `npx`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add @bleed00/dsh-claude-mem
```

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Requirements：- A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) installation with `dsh` on `PATH`.
- The claude-mem worker already running on its default port (`http://127.0.0.1:37700`). Override with the `baseUrl` config or the `DSH_MEM_BASE_URL` environment variable.

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Config：| Field | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:<37700 + uid % 100>` | Worker base URL. |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request timeout (ms). |
| `dedupe` | `true` | Collapse duplicate observations in query results (content fingerprint, never identity). |
| `platformSource` | unset | Optional platform filter; omitted = search all memory. |
| `project` | unset | Project name; defaults to the session cwd basename. |
| `injectContext` | `true` | Inject session-start context. |
| `ingest` | `false` | Save observed tool results as memories. |
| `summarize` | `false` | Summarize sessions on turn stop. |
| `toolFilter.names` | `read, write, edit, bash` | Tools observed when `ingest` is true. |
@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Config：Platform scoping is a **signal, never a restriction**: default requests are unfiltered, and `platformSource` only adds an opt-in filter.

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Duplicate handling：The worker can persist the same observation many times (a boilerplate "session
initiated" record, or a re-run tool result) — identical content, different `id`.
With `dedupe: true` (the default), query results collapse those copies: an
observation's **content fingerprint** is built from `title` + `subtitle` +
`text` + `narrative` + `facts` (normalized), so two entries that merely share a
generated title but differ in narrative are kept. The first copy (lowest `id`)
is retained. Structured results (`mem_get_observations`) are deduplicated by
fingerprint; rendered index/text results are deduplicated by exact rendered
row. Set `dedupe: false` to see the raw, unfiltered results.

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Example override in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`：```yaml
- id: claude-mem
  config:
    baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:37700
    platformSource: dsh

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `mem_search` | Search memory; returns an index (ids, titles, types). |
| `mem_timeline` | Get context around one observation. |
| `mem_get_observations` | Fetch full details for ids. |
| `mem_save` | Save one manual memory. |
| `mem_context` | Render the worker's session-start context text. |

The `mem-search` skill teaches the model the `search → filter → fetch` workflow that keeps token usage low.

@bleed00/dsh-claude-mem README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build   # tsc + tsdown → lib/index.js
pnpm test
```

The package targets Node ≥ 20.12, TypeScript 6.0, and is authored against the `@deepseek-ai/*` framework packages (cordis, schemastery, dsh-tools, dsh-llm, dsh-skill, dsh-agent).
